page.overview:
Who is Furuno?

Furuno is tall man usually wearing the standard Public Safety uniform suit.

Furuno, along with Shiina, is seen talking to Kishibe during the raid of the building where the Katana Devil is. Kishibe tells them that the police and 2nd Division will seal off the entrances of the 1st and ground floor. Kishibe then warns them of the Special 4th Division's members.
